_comment: Every setting of the pet, in one place: where it lives in ~/.claude-pet/config.json, its type, range and default, who may write it, and where the settings panel shows it. Read by prefs.ts (validation), reference.ts (the generated reference), the widget (panel, Rust guards). See docs/CONFIG.md.

prefs.doc: Interface language. auto follows macOS.
Colours of the bubble and the settings panel.
Stop every animation. system follows macOS's Reduce motion.
Start the daemon and the creature when you log in.
Once a day, ask github.com whether a newer claude-pet (or avatar) exists. The request carries nothing but the URL (docs/PRIVACY.md).
Install a detected update by itself (standalone install only; a signed release is required). Clones are told, never touched (docs/RISKS.md #12).
The creature's look: classic or an installed avatar (docs/AVATARS.md).
The creature's size at 100 % zoom, in pixels.
Zooming out never goes below this size.
Zooming in never goes above this size.
Zoom factor: shown size = nominal × zoom, kept between min and max. ⌘+ / ⌘− / ⌘0 on the creature.
How opaque the creature is.
Keep the creature above other windows.
One pastille per live Claude Code session under the creature.
Where the creature lives: on the desktop, as an icon in the menu bar (its title the creature's state, its menu the right-click menu), or both.
With several sessions on screen: how close the families stand. Tight makes them bigger, roomy leaves subagents more room to walk.
While its session works, the creature takes a small step now and then around its spot. Never at rest, never while it waits for you.
The creature tires as its session's context window fills (the status line's context %): a sweat drop from 70 %, worn out from 88 %. Nothing shown when the % is unknown.
Presets for what excites the creature, when it storms and how fast it calms down.
Load at which the creature storms; it calms down 10 points lower. Empty = the temperament's value.
Shortest time a look stays on screen, in seconds. Empty = default.
The creature sleeps; the sensors stop.
Watch the bytes arriving at claude processes, to see the model think (macOS nettop, only during a turn).
Read the conversation files for per-agent activity and real token counts. Only line types and token counts are kept.

Receive Claude Code's OpenTelemetry logs for real token counts, VS Code included. Only output-token counts are kept. Needs `claude-pet otel enable` once (it adds the export settings to ~/.claude/settings.json).
Click the creature to talk to Claude: a full agent that can edit files and run commands. Turning it on is only possible from the native menu.
Model for the creature's own Claude.
Where the creature stands on screen; saved when you drag it.

engine._comment: Allowed ranges for hand-written engine overrides (packages/core/src/config.ts). A value of the wrong type or out of range is ignored and reported, never used.
